item.title: Azzi Fudd's March Madness takeover appearing in commercials and social media spots
item.description: UConn star Azzi Fudd has become one of the most visible faces in women’s college basketball, thanks to a wave of TV ads and social media deals. Fudd appears in ads for brands like Planet Fitness, Marriott Bonvoy, and Geico. A sports marketing expert says companies now know how to use college athletes in real time. Fudd links her Planet Fitness partnership to injury recovery. She says her mom taught her to prioritize recovery early.
